[suffix]
# Productive rules that cannot be enumerated word by word.
# A stem of >= 3 characters followed by these endings flips -is- to -iz-.
ise ises ised ising isation isations iser isers

[same-in-both]
# Spelled identically in British and American English. A naive -ise -> -ize
# substitution mangles these into advertizing / surprizing / unsupervized, so they
# are matched as stems and never flagged.
wise rise prise advertis exercis promis surpris precis concis revis compromis
supervis unsupervis compris aris otherwis likewis nois rais prais franchis
merchandis disguis expertis premis paradis devis demis excis chastis despis
improvis televis advis appris enterpris ris
